summary: FY iteration frontend verification — all 9 primary assertions PASS. Dashboard header no longer renders CompanySwitcher/FYPicker (both moved to sidebar). Sidebar FY picker opens a modal listing FY 2026-27 (green 'CURRENT' tag) + FY 2025-26 / 2024-25 / 2023-24 (gold 'Read-only' tag). Selecting FY 2025-26 triggers client-side re-filter: Customer Will Pay changed ₹39,656→₹46,500 and You Pay Carrier changed ₹61,488.78→₹31,750, confirming FYContext propagates. Read-only banner (testID='fy-readonly-banner') appears with copy 'You are viewing FY 2025-26  (Read-only)' — no duplicate 'FY FY' — plus green CTA (testID='fy-banner-switch-current') 'Switch to FY 2026-27 →'. Banner is confirmed present on /shipments, /invoices and /ledger, and hidden when FY===2026-27. CTA click restores FY, hides banner instantly, and restores original totals. /sign-in has neither sidebar nor banner (AuthShell suppression works). No new console errors introduced by this iter — only pre-existing RN-Web deprecation warnings (shadow*/pointerEvents/textShadow*/useNativeDriver) and one 401 to ElevenLabs, all called out as pre-existing.

ui_bugs.issue: Top-right notification bell (BlockerBell) sits with a high absolute z-index and visually overlaps the right edge of the 'Switch to FY 2026-27 →' CTA on desktop widths. Functionally the CTA is still tappable (verified click restored FY), but the last character of the arrow/label is partially occluded. Consider adding right padding to the FYBanner or moving BlockerBell below the banner. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/fy-banner.tsx and /app/frontend/src/components/blocker-bell.tsx.

issues: Banner CTA visually clipped by notification bell overlay on desktop — see ui_bugs above. Functionality intact.
